reviews.text:
I love the treatment they give my dogs!!! Besides impeccable service, they are super humane and understanding.

I have a 15-year-old dog who had to undergo delicate emergency surgery, scheduled for the next business day. I went straight from the vet after the appointment on a Saturday afternoon, 2 hours before closing time, to try and get her a bath before the surgery, as she wouldn't be able to get one for 3 weeks afterwards.

They were packed (as is typical on a Saturday afternoon at the end of the workday), but they were super understanding and managed to give her an amazing bath!!!

PS. Everything went well with her, we'll be back soon for her next bath.
Just go and trust.
Wonderful service, truly qualified professionals who love animals. My pets are treated with so much love. I highly recommend them!!!!

Customer service leaves much to be desired.
I called twice and no one answered. I sent a message via WhatsApp and no one replied.

I believe they must not be in need of new customers.

All the stars in the sky for this wonderful, unique place that focuses on every detail and hits all the right notes! Camila, speechless, who are you? Sooooo polite, kind, communicative, makes us feel super comfortable, listens empathetically, interested in understanding in order to serve well. Then comes Sandra, decades of experience, affectionate, it seemed like she already knew Mada on the first meeting, she inspires confidence, credibility and is very competent, she goes above and beyond…
We are extremely satisfied, what a great meeting, congratulations and see you soon!

Excellent work done, my wife has complete confidence in them, and she is very meticulous, very dedicated and attentive to the pets. We are very satisfied with everything, we are already loyal customers. Congratulations and highly recommended! 👌🏼👏🏻 …

Camila is very attentive, responds quickly, and is very caring and attentive to pets. A team of professionals who put you at ease. We've been going there since it opened. It's where all our family and friends take their furry children.

I would like to register my dissatisfaction with the service related to scheduling. When I went to the location in person, I was informed that scheduling is done exclusively via WhatsApp, which I already consider inconsiderate to the customer. To make matters worse, messages sent via WhatsApp are not answered, making scheduling impossible and causing frustration. I hope this process will be reviewed in order to offer more efficient and respectful service.
Imagine a spectacular location, a top-notch team, and an unparalleled owner in the pet market. Congratulations Camila, keep being that exceptional professional you are.
Excellent team! Great attention to detail and dedication from everyone!
Always wonderful 🩷🩷🩷👏🏻👏🏻 …
My pet is very well taken care of.

The environment is welcoming and staffed by qualified professionals. My dog ​​is very well treated and the service is excellent. The owner (Camila) is always present, and her attention and energy make all the difference.
I must also mention the employee Ana Ferreira, whom my dog ​​adores, who gives a wonderful bath with great affection.
Camélia's aunts and uncles are amazing, and they've been taking care of our baby since he was 3 months old. That's 5 years of so much love, care, and trust! We love them so much! ❤️❤️❤️
Very good as always!!!
Excellent as always.
Our little Aurelinho 🐕 is always happy after his bath 🚿 with Aunt Sandra and the affection of everyone at Camélia. So, we're happy too. Until next time 🚿 …
Service was a 100000 out of 10...super caring and attentive with Mel, I HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!
There is no pet as wonderful as Camélia. They are incredible.
Excellent

I love all of this so much!

I love you all always!

Excellent service where my pet always leaves looking beautiful and smelling wonderful! I love your service and highly recommend it!
There's nothing better.

Congratulations!!!!
I loved the work of the professionals, Billy came out looking beautiful and super calm!! 😊 …
Best pet grooming in Tijuca! Very polite professionals, always treating pets with great care and affection!
The grooming service at Camélia is wonderful. The staff are attentive and caring with the pets.
Impeccable service, careful attention to the pets, and lots of love in the way they treat our beloved animals.
Alfredo, taking a wonderful bath!
Camila and her team are fantastic, caring, and creative! Congratulations to those who leave their pets with them!
I highly recommend Camélia!!! I've been bathing my dog ​​with them for years and he's absolutely IN LOVE with Ana!!! Their care for all the animals is wonderful!!!

For over 5 years, we've been taking great care of Chico, and now Amora too.

Everyone there has a huge affection for the pets (and it's reciprocal), and they really enjoy bath day. They always come back smelling great, well-groomed, and with shiny fur!

Excellent service and attention! From the initial contact via WhatsApp to the perfect results of the grooming and bathing. Our daughter always comes home beautiful and smelling wonderful. I highly recommend them ❤️

Wonderful as always. Perfect bath and grooming and VIP service.
I love this team, years of trust!
Very caring and meticulous professionals. They respond promptly. My dogs come back looking beautiful and smelling wonderful. Not to mention they take gorgeous photos!
The experience is always positive. Congratulations to the team.

To begin with, the energy of the place is wonderful! Camila creates a light and happy atmosphere, and it's contagious! She takes great care and affection with my Biju, who always leaves looking beautiful and smelling wonderful. Biju, I love going to Camélia! The service is always excellent, whether in person or online. The latter is very organized and will never let you forget about your bath. Camila, more and more success and love to you! I highly recommend it.
Excellent service with trustworthy professionals who treat your pet very well. I am very satisfied.

For the past 4 years, I've been taking my little girl there for baths and sanitary trims. She always comes back looking beautiful and smelling wonderful. The staff are lovely, super attentive, and committed to providing quality service. And to top it all off, the establishment is easily accessible, welcoming, and super clean. I recommend it without hesitation!
We love Camélia Estética Animal. My pet has always been very well treated and cared for there. I always leave my pet in good hands.
Hello! Complete trust. Kind people, full of love and care for pets. They leave looking beautiful and very happy. Everything is done for the well-being of the animals.
A welcoming, well-structured place that takes great care of our four-legged children, with highly qualified professionals. I highly recommend it!!!

I really enjoy taking Frida to Camélia for baths and grooming. The girls are very attentive and caring, Sandra is a competent and careful professional, and I'm always very satisfied; Frida always leaves looking beautiful.
Zé always comes back happy and smelling good.

If I had a thousand stars, I would give them to Camélia. My little Théo is treated super well by them.
I love them so much. Aunt Camila is amazing. ❤️💕 …

You can bring your pet without fear! They are super attentive, friendly, and provide excellent service. I want to highlight Shirley, a professional who always makes my dogs look wonderful and takes great care of them. Congratulations! ✨

Excellent pet shop, with very attentive and caring staff who treat our pets well. I take my dog ​​there regularly for baths, and he has always been very well taken care of and clearly likes the staff. The prices are fair, and for all these reasons I highly recommend the shop.
